description:
Open the complete record behind one map marker, or behind a saved reference.

    Returns: { record, recordRef, billing: { billed, unit, reason }, notice }.
    `record` is the same Record object search_offenders returns. `recordRef`
    ('mr_...') is a lasting reference: keep it to open the same record later,
    after the marker id has expired.

    Billing: one record open per person per map response, at the account's
    record-open rate (published price $0.035 per open; an account's agreed rate
    may differ) — so open a marker only when the user wants that person's
    record, not every marker in a view or along a route.
      - The same marker id again is free (`reason: 'marker_already_opened'`).
      - A new map_viewport, map_area, map_route or map_group answer carries new
        ids; opening the same person from it is a new charge.
      - Opening by `recordRef` is one record open, then free for 24 hours. A
        record just opened from a marker is also free by its reference for 24
        hours.
    `billing.billed` says whether THIS open was charged.

    Marker ids work for 24 hours (410 `marker_expired` after that). A 410
    `record_no_longer_listed` means the registry no longer lists the person; it
    is not billed.

    Auth: uses the caller's X-API-Key (request header or OFFENDERSEARCH_API_KEY env).

marker_id.description: A marker id ('mk_...') from map_viewport, map_area, map_route or map_group, or a saved record reference ('mr_...') from an earlier map_open_record.
marker_id.title: Marker Id

name: map_open_record
